summary: Horizon entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Horizon Zero Dawn
entries.definitive_edition: Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Remastered at current high settings

primary.why: The official Remastered release is the current high-fidelity route, and PlayStation's page states it includes The Frozen Wilds expansion. Windows keeps the strongest settings and capture ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered on Windows with the current patch and The Frozen Wilds content included. Use PS5 only if console capture consistency is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record PSN/account requirements and patch state for the PC Remastered route if capture logistics matter.

entries.title: Horizon Forbidden West
entries.definitive_edition: Horizon Forbidden West Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use native PC or PS5 route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Complete Edition at current high settings

primary.why: The Complete Edition bundles the base game with Burning Shores and the PC route gives the strongest capture/settings ceiling. The PS4 base release is important historically, but it cannot represent the Burning Shores content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Complete Edition with the current patch. Record storefront/build, graphics settings, PSN/account requirements if applicable, Burning Shores progress, difficulty, and whether the PS5 or PS4 branch was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console baseline and original Burning Shores target hardware
secondary.what_to_play: Use if console capture consistency is preferred.
secondary.why: Burning Shores was PS5-only before the PC Complete Edition route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch, account requirements, and Burning Shores inclusion; PS4 base release is not complete.
